title: game/data/rewards.json: the cards of the reward pick after a trainer battle (roguelite track RL-12b; logic/rewards.js)

kind.description: item: an item or pyramids into the bag; candy: a level item (lvlUp); evo: an evolution item (drawn only when a Billie of the team evolves with it); tutor: a move a Billie of the team can learn; held: a held item (RL-12c), drawn from items.json's held items that nobody on the team holds

pyramid.description: or the pyramid (pyramids.json), for kind item

weight.description: how often it is drawn against the others (0: never)
